verdict.rationale: xAI publishes a REST API reference with documented endpoint schemas (e.g. GET /v1/models), a gRPC reference, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at docs.x.ai/openapi.json. The quickstart and reasoning guides include runnable curl/Python/JavaScript examples, but nothing shows that the reference itself is interactive. missing for 10: evidence of an in-browser try-it/playground console within the API reference, runnable examples embedded in the reference pages themselves, independent hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
